definitionZh: 卷轴-时间线名称 CSS 属性用于定义一个命名的卷轴进度时间表的名称,通过在上下(或左右)之间滚动一个可滚动元素(滚动器)来推进. 滚动-时间线名称设置在提供时间轴的滚动器上.
sourceDefinition: The scroll-timeline-name CSS property is used to define the name of a named scroll progress timeline, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller) between top and bottom (or left and right). scroll-timeline-name is set on the scroller that will provide the timeline.
